status: Initial curated decision graph; human calibration pending.
interpretation_policy: Every outcome is an attributed selection aid, not an upstream instruction or authorization. Candidates are alternatives. Support entries are conditional companions.
selection_after_routing: Check the concrete deliverable and distinguish the alternatives named in the outcome.
Check source-specific requirements and installed host support.
Choose one workflow owner when alternatives both coordinate work.
Show evidence, limits, setup needs, and a qualified ID before invocation.

software.question: Is your main goal to change, assess, or understand software?

broken.question: Is something broken, flaky, or slower than expected?

understand.question: Is your main goal to gather evidence or understand something?

existing_system.question: Are you asking about an existing system or change?

historical_reason.question: Do you mainly want to know why it was built this way?

existing_change.question: Do you already have a change to evaluate or deliver?

shipping.question: Is your immediate goal to get a PR ready or land it?

testing.question: Is your immediate goal a test strategy or a regression test?

architecture.question: Is your main problem module design or architectural complexity?

decided.question: Is the intended outcome decided enough to start building?

ticket_graph.question: Do you have a dependency graph of ready implementation tickets?

experiment.question: Could a small executable experiment settle the open question?

large_effort.question: Is planning this effort too large for one conversation?

learning.question: Is your main goal to learn or understand a topic?

learning_workspace.question: Do you want saved lessons and a learning history over multiple sessions?

continuity.question: Do you need to transfer work, resume it, or catch up?

transfer.question: Do you need a portable handoff to a different agent, person, or directory?

writing.question: Is the deliverable writing, documentation, or agent instructions?

agent_document.question: Will an agent consume the document or skill you are authoring?

configuration.question: Is someone blocked by setup or configuration?

general_idea.question: Do you need to clarify a plan, decision, or idea?

project_directory.question: Are you working in a writable project directory?

debug.title: Diagnose a bug or performance regression
debug.rationale: Matt gives a staged diagnosis loop; Poteto mode offers distinct bug, performance, runtime and trace playbooks.
constraints: Choose one workflow owner.
Distinguish diagnosis-only from permission to fix.
Use benchmark-checklist only when making measurements; Poteto TDD is for a practical regression target.
debug.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

rationale.title: Find the reasons behind an existing design
rationale.rationale: Poteto why searches historical evidence categories; Matt research delegates primary-source reading into a cited note.
constraints: Confirm which historical sources are accessible.
Missing evidence stays unknown; do not invent rationale.
rationale.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

explanation.title: Explain an existing system
explanation.rationale: How traces mechanisms; teach combines mechanisms and rationale into an explanation.
constraints: Choose how for a technical walkthrough or teach for conversational understanding.
Matt codebase-design is useful vocabulary only when module shape is the question.
explanation.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

research.title: Research a focused technical question
research.rationale: Matt research produces a cited research artifact; Poteto how can investigate a focused technical mechanism.
constraints: Choose how only for a mechanism question; use research for broader reading legwork.
Define the question and evidence needed before delegating.
research.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

delivery.title: Get a pull request ready or ship it
delivery.rationale: Poteto mode distinguishes PR babysitting from independent shipping verification.
constraints: Select readiness versus shipping explicitly.
Shipping and external writes require the host and user authorization; this catalog grants none.
Matt pr is a body-writing reference, not a PR lifecycle coordinator.
delivery.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

review.title: Review an existing diff
review.rationale: Matt separates Standards and Spec reviewers; Poteto uses multiple model perspectives and supporting evidence.
constraints: Pin the base and exact reviewed contents.
Choose one review reporting contract and verify model/tool availability.
review.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

test.title: Choose a test-first workflow
test.rationale: Matt covers incremental feature and bug TDD at confirmed public seams; Poteto targets cheap practical bug regression checks.
constraints: Use matt/tdd for feature TDD and confirm test seams as its source requires.
Use poteto/tdd for a bug with a practical failing-before check; it explicitly allows other verification when a test is impractical.
The two IDs are alternatives, not interchangeable names.
test.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

design.title: Improve module design
design.rationale: Matt surveys a codebase for deepening opportunities; Poteto architect settles caller usage and module shape for a chosen change.
constraints: Use the survey when the target is unknown; architect when the change is known.
The vocabulary references support a workflow and do not replace it.
Poteto architect implements by default; explicitly request a design-only checkpoint when you only want advice.
design.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

parallel_build.title: Implement a ticket dependency graph
parallel_build.rationale: Matt explicitly manages a frontier of tickets on an integration branch; Poteto supplies orchestration and multi-phase playbooks.
constraints: Start from a settled spec and blocking edges.
Verify worktree and delegation support; choose one integration owner.
Do not substitute Matt experimental chief-of-staff by default.
parallel_build.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

build.title: Implement a settled piece of work
build.rationale: Matt runs a settled unit through its test/review flow; Poteto mode selects a feature or refactoring playbook.
constraints: Resolve intended behavior and test seams before relying on Matt implementation.
Check host adaptation before choosing Poteto.
build.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

prototype.title: Resolve an empirical design question
prototype.rationale: Both provide a prototype route that answers an observable question with a small executable artifact.
constraints: Define the question and a decision criterion.
For Poteto select the Prototype playbook.
Keep product preferences distinct from observable facts.
prototype.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

map_effort.title: Plan an effort larger than one session
map_effort.rationale: Matt maps unresolved decisions into a shared ticket map; Poteto designs a bespoke playbook for a substantial run.
constraints: Wayfinder is planning, not implementation; collapse decisions into a spec before building.
Choose one planning owner and an explicit handoff artifact.
map_effort.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

clarify_software.title: Clarify a software idea before specifying it
clarify_software.rationale: Matt conducts a full decision interview with domain documents; Poteto in-your-own-words first checks the agent understood the request.
constraints: These differ in depth: playback alone does not settle the design.
If playback exposes unresolved decisions, continue with an interview or Poteto help rather than assume them.
clarify_software.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

course.title: Learn through a persistent teaching workspace
course.rationale: Matt teach maintains lessons, resources and learning history across sessions.
constraints: Requires a writable learning workspace.
Do not select Poteto teach when persistent course artifacts are the intended result.
course.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

plain_teaching.title: Get a conversational explanation
plain_teaching.rationale: Poteto teach explains a body of work using mechanism and rationale investigations.
constraints: Best for an existing body of work or concept in context.
For a general learning program, choose the persistent-course branch.
plain_teaching.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

handoff.title: Create a portable handoff
handoff.rationale: Matt handoff creates a portable continuation document; decision trails can supply evidence for a long task.
constraints: Use at an appropriate phase boundary for portability.
A decision trail is supporting evidence, not a replacement handoff.
handoff.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

catch_up.title: Recover context or report progress
catch_up.rationale: Recall reconstructs recent context from available records; ketchup explains changes within the current chat.
constraints: Choose recall for recovery across records and ketchup for this-chat progress.
History tools and accessible source records are prerequisites.
catch_up.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

agent_writing.title: Write instructions or skills for agents
agent_writing.rationale: Matt supplies agent-document principles; automate-me derives a personal mode from observed work.
constraints: Use automate-me only for a personal mode supported by actual work history.
For a general new skill, consult the host skill-authoring workflow.
agent_writing.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

prose.title: Write or edit technical prose
prose.rationale: Technical-writing structures technical documents; unslop edits prose style.
constraints: Use Matt pr only when the deliverable is a PR body.
Experimental writing-beats/fragments/shape stay opt-in in this compilation.
prose.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

setup.title: Resolve setup or configuration prerequisites
setup.rationale: These solve different setup needs: human-only steps, Matt repo conventions, or Poteto model configuration.
constraints: Select the matching setup need; do not run all candidates.
Wizard is appropriate only for steps the agent cannot perform.
Setup-pstack configures a supported host; it does not install Codex compatibility.
setup.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

unclear.title: Ask a native router to narrow the situation
unclear.rationale: Both collections already include guidance for choosing a skill or sequence.
constraints: Choose a collection guide rather than running both full flows.
If the task falls outside these collections, say so instead of forcing a skill recommendation.
unclear.classification: Curator interpretation; compare candidates rather than invoking all of them.

clarify_general.title: Clarify an idea without a project workspace
clarify_general.rationale: Matt grill-me is the stateless interview wrapper for situations without a working directory.
constraints: Use grill-with-docs instead when the interview should leave project glossary and decision records.
The interview clarifies decisions; it does not authorize execution.
clarify_general.classification: Curator interpretation; source-grounded candidate, not an invocation.
